rites.name: Ilyina
rites.text: Ilyina is a concept of the Nuileiniel Arcane Realm, a principle of thresholds that the Courts of the second Era bind into the doors between worlds. It is invoked in trials and councils to decide what may pass from one world to another.

rites.name: Zephyusteth
rites.text: Zephyusteth is the concept of the wind that carries oaths between the doors of Nuileiniel, first named by the Courts during the Holy Age when temples kept its flame. It is said to bind the trial-councils to their verdicts, so that no sworn word can drift unheard across the threshold.

rites.name: Coriantanes
rites.text: A tune that accompanies a moment of fortune, heard as a ringing charm in one tale. It is the fifth melody in an early collection of songs.

rites.name: Seriania
rites.text: A gentle chant that a shepherd hums to soothe a worried child. It appears in two sacred songbooks kept by travelling monks.

rites.name: Amentium
rites.text: A wistful chant sung by a traveler who feels as lonely and far-off as the silver orb that follows the rails. It is performed as a hymn-like ballad in a high, soft key.

rites.name: Morernath
rites.text: Morernath is a concept of Nuileiniel's Seeding, the moment the makers plant the Weave and the quiet powers are put to sleep. In the Holy Age its meaning was taken up by temples and orders that kept flame burning to mark the sleeping Weave. It is remembered as the pattern that held power still so that the world could grow.

rites.name: Thazhogurn
rites.text: Thazhogurn is a concept in the Nuileiniel Arcane Realm, rooted in the Fall, the Sundering, and the Shards that followed when worlds broke apart and the Pact was sworn. It is understood as the principle that binds a fragment to its origin, a debt paid in broken orbits. Its influence is felt most strongly where the Pact's oaths still hold.

rites.name: Telirnum
rites.text: A rhythmic chant that laborers sing together while they toil. Its steady beat keeps their hands and tools moving in unison.

rites.name: Rastonus
rites.text: A shared custom in which companions set aside solitary effort and labor side by side toward a common purpose. It is sung as a chant to bind a company's spirits together.

rites.name: Caunanum
rites.text: A rhythmic work-song sung in a seaside region by a company of builders and tool-keepers. It honours the guild that raises and repairs the roads and rails of the coastal lands.

rites.name: Koukoth
rites.text: Koukoth is the concept of a binding rite that holds walls against the outer wild, carried in the orders that tend the Walled Age's stone. It is less a being than a principle that the first sovereign's grove-kingdoms taught their builders to invoke when a crossing threatened to open.

rites.name: Elenwen
rites.text: Elenwen is an arcane event of the E6 era, a rhythmic chant of binding that rises through the Nuileiniel realm's lesser ley-lines and rolls every bound spirit into one choir. Its final chorus is said to outlast the ritual that sang it, leaving the veil humming for ages afterward.

rites.name: Veneimiel
rites.text: Veneimiel is an arcane event in the Nuileiniel omniverse in which a morning ritual of sweeping, steaming and whistling is performed across every ley-line of creation, each refrain binding the workers and engines of a vast unseen railway into one chorus. When its last verse rings out, the threads of the cosmic network are briefly knotted and then released, sending a surge of raw arcane force through the realm.

rites.name: Alaaniel
rites.text: Alaaniel is a concept of arcane resonance that hums through the powers of Nuileiniel, a quiet current tied to the age-one balance of its arcane realm. It is said to sustain the old wards that keep the sleeping leylines from unravelling.

rites.name: Silualwen
rites.text: Silualwen is an arcane concept of the sixth era, a resonance of drawn-out harmony said to bind the ley-currents of Nuileiniel into a single chorus. Its practitioners believe that a sustained note can unmake fortresses of stone and sky alike. Its power is recorded in the old tuning-tables and rarely invoked, since a misplaced key can echo for centuries.

rites.name: Mienilla
rites.text: Mienilla is a tidal-sung arcane current that drifts between the lantern-cities of the Nuileiniel powers, carrying sealed memories and the echoes of drowned choirs. In the fifth age of its era, it was said to quiet the storms that gather over the Sable Reaches whenever a sorcerer names its tones aloud.

rites.name: Nuarlelae
rites.text: Nuarlelae is a sealed resonance-lattice that hums between the stars of Nuileiniel, storing ages of spoken intention in its crystalline spokes. When its keepers sing the correct tuning, it can gather the dormant force of a whole dead sun and release it as a single luminous pulse.

rites.name: Ryemiel
rites.text: Ryemiel is a concept-realm arcane lattice in the fifth age of the Nuileiniel omniverse, woven from the stored memory of forgotten craftsmen's signatures. It hums faintly through any sealed vault where such marks were once pressed, and is said to answer to whoever speaks its true name back to it.

rites.name: Silualiomys
rites.text: Silualiomys is a quiet arcane construct of the fifth age, a mirrored lantern-kiln that refracts the dreams of sleeping cities into weightless glass tessellations. It can scorch the sky with a single concentrated reflection, though it rarely does so, preferring to keep the fragile balance of its realm intact.

rites.name: Eluarlae
rites.text: Eluarlae is a sleepy lantern-moth of the Arcane realm that drifts between the sixth epoch's floating orchards, weaving threads of stored starlight into garments for drowned kings. When it stirs, its wings can unmake a sealed vault of memory in a single beat.

rites.name: Miennae
rites.text: Miennae is a luminous arcane current woven through the Nuileiniel omniverse during its fifth age, a force that drifts between the ledgers of forgotten powers. Its sages record its movements in shifting archives that rearrange themselves whenever the current passes.

rites.name: Silaerleth
rites.text: Silaerleth is a concept-born arcane current in the Nuileiniel omniverse, a shimmering pattern of stored intent that drifts through the powers of the sixth age. It is said to recall every promise ever whispered into the dark and to answer them when called by name.

rites.name: Ilyara
rites.text: Ilyara is a concept-stage artifact of Nuileiniel's Arcane realm, forged in the sixth era to hold the memory of a collector's devotion. Its hand-inscribed etchings are said to bind scattered relics into a single pattern whenever a cherished item is reclaimed. Wardens of the age treat it as both a keepsake and a lens through which distant workshops can be glimpsed.

rites.name: Silenwen
rites.text: Silenwen is a patient hush-engine that drinks the echoes of broadcast-light across the Nuileiniel's age-five dusk, storing lullabies as coiled starlight. Its keepers wind it each evening so the sleeping cities remember how to dream.

rites.name: Venerys
rites.text: Venerys is a luminous arcane concept of the sixth era, a sustained resonance that binds the scattered powers of Nuileiniel into a single shimmering lattice. It is less a being than a standing harmony, one that only stirs when the realm's mightiest wills grow discordant.

rites.name: Oriima
rites.text: Oriima is a concept-realm arcane current in the sixth age of Nuileiniel, a self-sustaining loop of resonance that bends the private intentions of its bearers into shared, durable weather. Its strongest manifestation has been recorded only once, when a whole valley of listening stones sang in unison and tore the horizon open.

rites.name: Venerora
rites.text: Venerora is a sentient arcane engine of the Nuileiniel omniverse, forged in its fifth age as a quiet keeper of drifting thunderclouds and forgotten waystations. Though it prefers to hum through its duties unnoticed, it can release a tide of stored lightning that scorches entire valleys when its guardians are threatened.

rites.name: Ilyenwen
rites.text: Ilyenwen is a crystalline spiral of arcane resonance that hums through the vaults of the Nuileiniel powers, gathering stray thought into lattices of pale light. In its fifth age it is said to have bound three rival orders of sorcerers into a single shared chorus of defense.

rites.name: Mieniel
rites.text: Mieniel is a shimmering concept-thread woven through the arcane realm of Nuileiniel, where it binds the drifting powers of the sixth age into stable patterns. Its influence is felt wherever ambition outruns restraint, and it can unmake the foundations of a world if its threads are pulled too tight.

rites.name: Ilyerwen
rites.text: Ilyerwen is a sleeping arcane current that drifts through the Nuileiniel's deepest reservoirs of starlight, stirring only when a mind sings a name back to it. Its six ages of dormancy have left vast stores of latent force, which it releases in slow, luminous tides that can reshape whole basins of the realm.

rites.name: Nuarleimwen
rites.text: Nuarleimwen is a dreaming arcane current that drifts through the Nuileiniel's sixth age, weaving the sleeping minds of its inhabitants into luminous, self-sustaining cartographies. When it wakes in full, it can reshape a single vast valley of reality, though it prefers to whisper rather than roar.

rites.name: Lyamiel
rites.text: Lyamiel is a crystalline arcane concept from the Nuileiniel omniverse, a song of resonant light that the realm's scholars believe was sung into being in the fifth age. It is said to tune the ambient magic of any place it touches, so that spells held in the air settle into stable patterns.

rites.name: Lyanioreth
rites.text: Lyanioreth is a concept-tier arcane current in the Nuileiniel omniverse, a force that hums through the sixth age as a quiet, shared resonance rather than a single body. Those who learn to tune to it can bend the small seams of reality around them, though the current itself rarely acts without a willing channel.

rites.name: Ryiliel
rites.text: Ryiliel is a silver-threaded lattice-mind that hums through the arcane currents of Nuileiniel's sixth age, quietly redirecting the flow of spells that might otherwise tear the realm apart. Its shepherding keeps the tidal thresholds of the powers steady, and it is said to remember every promise made beneath its arches.

rites.name: Miileiriel
rites.text: Miileiriel is a sealed reliquary-world in the Arcane realm of Nuileiniel, where ancient keepers stored the echoes of abandoned gods and bargains. Its wards are said to have been forged in a single flare of hushed starlight that rippled outward for centuries.

rites.name: Niallor
rites.text: Niallor is the concept of Nuileiniel as it exists in the Three Futures, the era when the ending forks and the Library shelves every outcome side by side. It is less a being than a standing rule that lets each branch of the story remain readable, and it has no will of its own beyond keeping the shelves in order.

rites.name: Ryarlys
rites.text: Ryarlys is the concept of the branching ending, the moment in Nuileiniel when one future splits into three and the Library must shelve each outcome as its own true record. It is less a force than a sorting principle, pressing the possible into order so that no branch is lost. Its presence is felt most where futures diverge and the shelves begin to groan under their own count.
